_comment: VaporChain testnet parameters. Copy and edit for your network. Copyright (c) 2026 VaporChain / muthu2201. Provenance: VAPOR-6eabb1be532bdef4
_economics: Gas is priced as infrastructure cost: credit_price = acredit minted per uusdc (1e12 / USD-per-CREDIT; 2e10 => 1 CREDIT = 50 USDC, an ERC-20 transfer ~0.0017 USDC at the 1 gwei floor). quota_weight is the gas of sponsorship earned per uusdc of fee; keep quota_weight * sponsor_max_fee_per_gas / credit_price < 0.5 so paying fees to farm sponsored gas always loses money (see docs/benchmarks/mainnet-sim.md).
_bonding: Base sponsorship quota is bought with USDC bonded behind an app (no attestors, no identity checks): gas_per_bonded_usdc gas per epoch per bonded USDC, linear so splitting a bond across fake apps gains nothing; unbonding_blocks keeps withdrawn capital locked (must be >= epoch_length_blocks).
